title: Bear cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='28' r='12' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='28' r='12' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='28' r='7' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='28' r='7' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#A0714F'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#EFD5B0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4A2C1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='2' ry='1' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 60 Q46 65 43 63' stroke='#5C3A22' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 60 Q54 65 57 63' stroke='#5C3A22' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='46' rx='6.5' ry='7' fill='#3A2318'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='46' rx='6.5' ry='7' fill='#3A2318'/>

  <circle cx='36' cy='43.5' r='2.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43.5' r='2.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='49' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='34.5' cy='47.5' r='0.8' fill='#FFF7D6'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='47.5' r='0.8' fill='#FFF7D6'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#E89B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#E89B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#A0714F'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#EFD5B0'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-20 27 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(20 73 82)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='86' r='4' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='86' r='4' fill='#D4A574'/>
</svg>
